thread.title: Foxconn says investigating labor conditions at China factory used for Amazon

author: admin
title: Foxconn says investigating labor conditions at China factory used for Amazon
text:
Home Technology Foxconn says investigating labor conditions at China factory used for Amazon Foxconn says investigating labor conditions at China factory used for Amazon June 11, 2018 admin Technology 0
NEW YORK (Reuters) – Contract producer Foxconn mentioned on Sunday it’s investigating a plant in China that makes gadgets for Amazon.com Inc ( AMZN.O ), after a U.S. watchdog group criticized what it described as harsh working situations on the manufacturing facility. FILE PHOTO: Visitors are seen at a Foxconn sales space on the World Intelligence Congress in Tianjin, China May 19, 2018. REUTERS/Stringer
A 94-page report by New York-based China Labor Watch that adopted a nine-month investigation cited extreme hours, low wages, insufficient coaching and an overreliance on “dispatch” or short-term staff in violation of Chinese legislation on the Hengyang Foxconn plant in Hunan province, which makes Echo Dot sensible audio system and Kindle e-readers.
“We are carrying out a full investigation of the areas raised by that report, and if found to be true, immediate actions will be taken to bring the operations into compliance with our Code of Conduct,” Foxconn Technology Group mentioned in an announcement emailed to Reuters.
Taiwan-based Foxconn, recognized formally as Hon Hai Precision Industry Co Ltd ( 2317.TW ), is the world’s largest contract electronics producer and employs greater than 1,000,000 individuals. FILE PHOTO: An Amazon.com Inc driver stands subsequent to an Amazon supply truck in Los Angeles, California, U.S., May 21, 2016. REUTERS/Lucy Nicholson/File picture
Foxconn, which additionally makes Apple Inc ( AAPL.O ) iPhones, got here underneath fireplace in 2010 for a spate of suicides at vegetation in China. Foxconn pledged to enhance working situations.
China Labor Watch mentioned its investigation discovered that about 40 p.c of staff on the plant have been dispatch staff, far exceeding the 10 p.c restrict underneath Chinese legislation. Dispatch staff have been paid on the identical price for normal and additional time hours, moderately than time and a half as required, mentioned China Labor Watch Program Officer Elaine Lu.
“They were underpaid,” Lu mentioned. “That’s illegal.”
Dispatch staff earned 14.5 yuan ($2.26) per hour, the report mentioned. Workers additionally put in additional than 100 additional time hours monthly throughout peak season, way over the 36 hours allowed by legislation, and a few labored for 14 consecutive days.
Amazon mentioned it audited the manufacturing facility in March and located additional time and use of dispatch staff have been “issues of concern.”
“We immediately requested a corrective action plan from Foxconn,” Amazon mentioned in an announcement. It mentioned it’s monitoring Foxconn’s response and “compliance with our Supplier Code of Conduct. We are committed to ensuring that these issues are resolved.”
Foxconn mentioned in an earlier assertion that it “works hard to comply with all relevant laws and regulations” the place it operates and conducts common audits. “If infractions are identified, we work to immediately rectify them,” it mentioned. Reporting by Alwyn Scott in New York and Reuters Beijing bureau; Editing by Chris Reese and Sandra Maler
